svg.text: Feed support: pipe / P2 / P3 nominal section
297 mm paper / 440 mm pipe-frame outside width / dimensions in mm
TRIAL DETAIL - NOT AN ORDER APPROVAL
A. M3 x 40 passes through P2 + pipe + P3
Pipe 15
Bolt grip: 2 + 15 + 15 = 32
Two washers: max. 2 total
Metal nut: max. 3
Thread beyond nut: 40 - 32 - 2 - 3 = 3
Sleeve: OD6 / ID3.2 / length12
P3 faces inward; its closed back rests on the pipe, NOT directly on the P2 base.
Drill matching clearance holes. Insert sleeves from an open pipe end before closing the frame.
Sleeve length must match the real inside width. Do not pull a gap closed by crushing the pipe.
B. Upper M10 rod / horizontal positions only
P2 outer base faces at X = +/-222; pipe outer faces at +/-220
Upper rod: nominal 400 long
Each end: 3 clearance to closed back / 10 engagement in slot (nominal).
495 cannot fit between these blind ends (406 apart). Measure the assembled gap before cutting.

g.text: 4 supports: P3 through-bolts 8 x M3x40; P2 cross-bolts 8 x M3x30; metal sleeves 16.
This subset: M3 nuts 16 / washers 32. Bearing-cap fasteners are counted separately.

svg.text: P2 source: WorldPrinter.scad. P3 uses the raised guide below, not the original short part.
Motor, gears, paper guides, manufacturing tolerances and strength are not verified by this section.
C. Height integration: low frame / raised upper-roll guide
Pipe centre Z30.5; P2 bearing offset +38: lower rod Z68.5.
Covered roller R6 + upper bearing R15: upper rod Z89.5.
Paper contact plane: Z74.5 (nominal; measure roller coating).
Raised P3: 87.5 high x25 wide x15 deep; blind back2.
Slot width10.2; local x35..70 opens upward.
Hole pattern and axial stack unchanged: M3x40, 2 per guide.
Original short P3 would end at Z56: do not use in this layout.
Print one guide for fit first. Do not clamp the floating rod.
Height sketch separates the end guide from the bearing contact position; not a full 3D collision/strength test.
